PROVINCIAL COUNCILS ELECTIONS ACT, No. 2 OF 1988
Filling of a Vacancy in the Central Province Provincial Council

WHEREAS the Secretary of the Central Province Provincial Council has informed the Election Commission underSection 65(1) of the Provincial Councils Elections Act, No. 2 of 1988 that a vacancy has occured in the membership ofthe Central Province Provincial Council by reason of Death;

And whereas the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political Party to which the memberbelonged was required by the Election Commission under Section 65(2) of the aforesaid Act, to nominate an eligibleperson to fill such vacancy;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has nominated Mr. Asoka Priyantha BandaraHerath Herath Mudiyanselage to fill such vacancy;

The Election Commission, acting in terms of Section 65(2) of the Provincial Councils Elections Act, No. 2 of1988, read with the Nineteenth Amendment to the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, dohereby declare Mr. Asoka Priyantha Bandara Herath Herath Mudiyanselage, elected as a member of the above ProvincialCouncil from the Administrative District of Nuwara-Eliya in respect of which such vacancy occured.
